titles.romaji: Hana no Mahou Tsukai Mary Bell
titles.native: 花の魔法使いマリーベル

description:
Mary Bell is a fairy of flowers and will only appear when someone is in need of her help. When a couple has a hard time running a flower shop, she appears in front of their two children. With that, she starts her important task of helping the couple make their flower shop a complete success.

(Source: Anime News Network)
